description: Validation diagnostic, with no recipe change. Run it immediately after a candidate tip is kept (the H2.6.2 successor, or whatever is the tip once H2.6.3/H3.2.1 are stacked). Seeds 3–12 have driven about 10 keep decisions and carry a winner's curse. Run the committed recipe offline on fresh seeds 13–22 through the harness (benchmark.run --seed 13 --n 10). Record per-seed accuracy, mean and std, and the pooled 20-seed mean with its SE. Do not edit submissions/arena/.
